author: National Geographic
description:
Will Smith joins local Waorani elder Penti Baihua in the Amazon rainforest to search for the world's biggest snake: the giant green anaconda. After tracking down the anaconda, the team secures genetic samples from the massive female snake, leading to a groundbreaking scientific discovery.
